source_snapshot.procedure: Prepare system spec and motherboard; visually check switch location.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/MEDIUM; board-revision/spec identity, SUT-linked photos and no actuation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Manual visual boundary accepted, though wording conflates location and position.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds identity/evidence and forbids switch actuation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-02/05/06 require board/switch/location oracle; ED-04/07/08 require safe access; ED-36/38 reserve verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the specifically designated motherboard switch is physically populated at the board-revision-defined coordinate/designator and accessible/oriented as shown by the approved system drawing, without testing or changing its electrical setting.
original_method: Confirm SUT, motherboard assembly/PCB revision and layout drawing; establish safe powered-down/ESD inspection state as required; qualified operator opens the approved access path, locates the switch using silkscreen and nearby reference components, and captures scale/orientation photographs; compare presence, designator, coordinate and mechanical orientation to the drawing; close chassis without actuating the switch.
manual_activity: Qualified operator safely exposes and photographs the named motherboard switch; agent may compare supplied photos with the approved drawing.
required_inputs: Exact switch reference designator/function and approved layout/spec revision
Expected coordinate/orientation and visible reference features
Safe inspection power/chassis/ESD procedure and photo requirements
safety_requirements: Use approved power/access state and ESD controls
Do not touch, toggle or electrically probe the switch
Stop on uncertain designator, inaccessible/hazardous location or suspected damage
agent_execution_scope: Inspect drawing metadata and analyze SUT-linked photos
Do not open chassis, actuate switch, infer electrical state or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve board and switch identity plus authoritative drawing
Approve physical coordinate/orientation and inspection state
Review location evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can establish physical placement; its reference to 'position' must not silently expand a location-only source into a setting test.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use revision-bound annotated photographs against the authoritative motherboard layout.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System spec, motherboard and switch-location comparison remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Document the switch reference designator and board coordinates with orientation/scale photos tied to exact PCB revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable identity, authoritative drawing, safe access and a strict no-actuation boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct switch setting elsewhere does not satisfy physical-location coverage, and checking location does not authorize changing the setting.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Nearby switches or a different PCB revision can look identical; photo perspective can hide the silkscreen unless reference features are included.

project_override_considerations: If 'location' was intended to mean lever setting, create or approve separate state coverage; do not move hardware under this inspection-only row.
expected_evidence: Approved layout/spec revision and switch designator/function
Annotated overview and close-up photos with silkscreen/reference features

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request switch location verification; wording errors do not create competing acceptance states.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This remains a valid manual inspection when the exact board drawing and safe access are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2283 Wistron-HW-00176-V003: approve SUT and motherboard assembly/PCB revision, exact switch reference designator/function and authoritative layout/spec revision; define expected coordinate/orientation and photographic reference features, safe powered/unpowered chassis/ESD inspection procedure, and confirm this row checks physical location only—not lever position or switch actuation.

review_improvement: Preserves the location-only physical coverage while preventing a similarly located control or a switch-setting test from being substituted.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical placement is a configuration-management property tied to PCB revision and reference designator. A photo of an unlabeled switch or a different board revision cannot establish compliance, and moving the switch would introduce an unrelated electrical-state test. The evidence therefore must show both overview and silkscreen-level identity against the approved drawing while maintaining a no-touch inspection boundary.
